profile.name: WSOL PUBLIC COMPANY LIMITED
profile.nameRemark: Listed company which has possibility to be delisted
profile.businessType: WSOL Public Company Limited is a Thai technology company that originated from the provision of top-up kiosk services and has since diversified into multiple business segments with the ambition of becoming a leader in financial technology (FinTech). The Company develops integrated products and customer touchpoints within its own comprehensive ecosystem, designed to maximize accessibility and engagement with consumers.At present, WSOL has expanded into a broader range of businesses, with a clear focus on leveraging technology to meet the evolving needs of Thai consumers in today?s digital era and to transcend existing limitations. Guided by its aspiration ?to become a leader in future technologies,? the Company is committed to building and strengthening its own integrated ecosystem to effectively respond to consumer demands and deliver seamless, technology-driven experiences.
profile.address: 238 Bang Khun Thian - Chai Thale Road, Samae Dam Subdistrict, Bang Khun Thian District Bangkok 10150
profile.dividendPolicy: The Company has a dividend policy of not less than 40 percent of the profit for the year, based on net profit according to the specific financial statements after deduction of corporate income tax and various reserves as required by law and company regulations each year. The dividend payment will be considered taking into account various factors for the benefit of the shareholders as a priority, such as the Company's operational performance and financial status, reserves set aside for future investments, reserves set aside for loan repayments, or as internal working capital within the Company. The dividend payment will not have a significant impact on the Company's normal operations, as deemed appropriate or suitable by the Company's board of directors.
